items.t: Ignition switch can slip out of Run (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch (recall 14V-047)

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out (recall)
items.job: Replace electric power steering motor (recalls 10V-073 / 14V-153)
items.note: Out-of-recall repairs reported by owners average about $500-$1,000.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Off (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and keys (recall 14V-171)

items.t: Key gets stuck in the ignition
items.job: Replace shifter park switch/shifter assembly or lock cylinder

items.t: Fuel pump module can crack and leak gas (recall)
items.job: Replace or repair fuel pump module (recalls 09V-419 / 12V-459)

items.t: Timing chain rattle and tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner

items.t: Ignition coil failure and misfire
items.job: Replace ignition coil pack and spark plugs
items.note: RepairPal lists about $244-$372 for an ignition coil on the closely related Cavalier.

items.t: Turn signal and headlight switch stops working
items.job: Replace multifunction (combination) switch
items.note: Rerev puts this at about $166 with labor.

items.t: Check gas cap message and check engine light
items.job: Replace gas cap (or filler neck if corroded)

items.t: Front lower control arm bushings wear out
items.job: Replace front lower control arm(s) and align

items.t: Manual transmission grinds when shifting
items.job: Rebuild or replace manual transmission
items.note: Check the clutch first; a clutch job costs much less.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts roughly
items.job: Diagnose, adjust or replace shift cable; rebuild if worn
items.note: Wide range: a cable is cheap, a rebuilt transmission is not.

items.t: Doors lock and unlock by themselves
items.job: Replace door lock actuator

items.t: Water pump leak
items.job: Replace water pump

items.t: Shifter may show Park when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Secure shift cable clip (recall 09V-073)

items.t: Weak head protection near the roof (recall)
items.job: Install added roof-rail padding (recall 07V-014)

items.t: Headlight shields can come loose and cause glare (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace headlamps (recall 04V-560)

items.t: Driver curtain airbag wiring can short (recall)
items.job: Repair and reroute side-impact sensor harness (recall 15V-500)

items.t: Aftermarket ignition switch can slip out of Run (recall)
items.job: Replace with correct ignition switch (recall 14E-021 / 14V-047)

items.t: Steering locks up while driving
items.job: Replace electric power steering motor/sensor (often under recall)
items.note: Check for the free recall repair first.
